thread:
yara: FYI customer Nereid just handed over a LoRA patch (v0.9). I merged into `cust/nereid/lora-merged` and QA saw formatting shifts in numbered lists and dates.

oliver: paste a quick example?

yara: short repro from our smoke set:
```
Prompt: "Provide dates for product releases."
Gold: "1) Jan 10, 2024
2) Mar 15, 2024
3) Jul 2, 2024"
Merged: "1) Jan 10, 2024\n2) Mar 15, 2024\n3) Jul 2, 2024\n\n" <-- trailing newline token appears
```

kai: trailing newline + list jitter usually = tokenizer/special-token misalignment. Did Nereid include tokenizer metadata?

yara: yes: `lora_info.json` has `tokenizer: spm` and a `special_tokens` list. Our serving models use `redwood-x1-bpe`.

oliver: quick mitigation: run special-token remap and compute token_seq_diff on the smoke pack. If diff > 0.5% fail merge.

yara: ran remap with `tools/remap_specials.py` -> token_shift_ratio dropped from 0.011 to 0.002. Good.

qa-bot: started quick-eval job=33122 logs=https://ci.redwood/jobs/33122/logs

kai: also quantify quantization sensitivity. We saw int4 introduce extra noise on list/datetime tokens historically. Run FP16 vs int8 vs int4.

yara: eval command used:
```
./bin/run_quick_eval \
  --model artifacts/nereid/merged-v0.9 \
  --prompts evals/nereid_smoke_120.json \
  --quant fp16,int8,int4 \
  --out /tmp/nereid_eval_summary.json
```

yara: preliminary: fp16 acc 0.75, int8 0.73, int4 0.64. Most regressions in date parsing and list items.

oliver: plan: 1) require explicit special-token remap when metadata.tokenizer != model.tokenizer; 2) add `check_token_shift.py` pre-merge CI hook that computes tokenized-seq-diff; 3) default new customer LoRAs to int8 in Dedicated/Private until we validate int4 for that artifact.

kai: agree. Also add SE checklist: request original tokenizer model or token map to avoid repeated remaps.

yara: I'll open a small PR with remap helper + CI check + onboarding doc snippet. Will re-run eval after PR. ETA: later today.

oliver: thanks 44d ping here with PR link and final eval artifacts.
